## Re-bind credentials before activating
This workflow was created in Dustin's project, but the referenced credentials live in Elan's project and will NOT resolve at runtime across projects. Elan must open each node below and re-select the credential in the n8n UI:
- Get Twine posts (Supabase) -> httpHeaderAuth "Supabase API" (dKAr5wx2rnvTPYOY)
- Scrape reactions (Apify) -> apifyOAuth2Api "Apify OAuth2 API" (LLPghAk926Hh8qyh)
- DM Dustin -> slackOAuth2Api "Slack OAuth2 API" (qnZtXBwMt2ZcMSsj)

## LinkedIn Employee Engagement — Weekly (OKR)
**Leave INACTIVE for human review.**

1. Creds to bind in UI (see red note): Supabase (dKAr5wx2rnvTPYOY), Apify (LLPghAk926Hh8qyh), Slack (qnZtXBwMt2ZcMSsj).
2. Metric = name-match to the 38-person staff ROSTER. The ROSTER array and HEADCOUNT (= ROSTER.length = 38) live at the top of the "Compute metrics" Code node — edit the roster there.
3. Metric 1 (per post) = distinct roster members who reacted ÷ 38, whole %. Metric 2 (weekly) = the average of the per-post Metric-1 rates across the week's posts.
4. Timezone: set workflow Settings -> Timezone = Asia/Jerusalem so the Monday 08:00 trigger fires in Israel time.
